defs.d: A male partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.
A male friend.
To make (something) better; to increase the value or productivity (of something).
defs.ex: Buying more servers would improve performance.

defs.d: To become better.
defs.ex: I have improved since taking the tablets.

defs.d: The interior bottom or surface of a house or building; the supporting surface of a room.
defs.ex: The room has a wooden floor.

defs.d: Ground (surface of the Earth, as opposed to the sky or water or underground).
To cover or furnish with a floor.
defs.ex: floor a house with pine boards

defs.d: To strike down or lay level with the floor; to knock down.
A stopping place.
A place where workers are stationed.
(usually passive) To put in place to perform a task.
defs.ex: I was stationed on the pier.

defs.d: To put in place to perform military duty.
defs.ex: I was stationed at Fort Richie.

defs.d: Sucrose in the form of small crystals, obtained from sugar cane or sugar beet and used to sweeten food and drink.
A specific variety of sugar.
To add sugar to; to sweeten with sugar.
defs.ex: John heavily sugars his coffee.

defs.d: To make (something unpleasant) seem less so.
defs.ex: She has a gift for sugaring what would otherwise be harsh words.

defs.d: Used in place of shit!
defs.ex: Oh, sugar!

defs.d: An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.
defs.ex: It’s a good thing that television doesn’t transmit smell.

defs.d: A device for receiving television signals and displaying them in visual form.
defs.ex: I have an old television in the study.

defs.d: To watch television.
Taking care; attentive to potential danger, error or harm; cautious.
defs.ex: He was a slow and careful driver.

defs.d: Conscientious and painstaking; meticulous.
defs.ex: They made a careful search of the crime scene.

defs.d: The tendency to work persistently. Diligence.
defs.ex: Over the years, their industry and business sense made them wealthy.

defs.d: Businesses of the same type, considered as a whole. Trade.
defs.ex: The software and tourism industries continue to grow, while the steel industry remains troubled.

defs.d: The act of instructing, teaching, or furnishing with information or knowledge.
defs.ex: Instruction will be provided on how to handle difficult customers.

defs.d: An instance of the information or knowledge so furnished.
Something which is fair (in various senses of the adjective).
defs.ex: When will we learn to distinguish between the fair and the foul?

defs.d: A woman, a member of the ‘fair sex’; also as a collective singular, women.
To smoothen or even a surface (especially a connection or junction on a surface).
To bring into perfect alignment (especially about rivet holes when connecting structural members).
Beautiful, of a pleasing appearance, with a pure and fresh quality.
defs.ex: Monday's child is fair of face.

defs.d: Unblemished (figuratively or literally); clean and pure; innocent.
defs.ex: After scratching out and replacing various words in the manuscript, he scribed a fair copy to send to the publisher.

defs.d: Any of a class of organic compounds (such as ethanol) containing a hydroxyl functional group (-OH).
Ethanol.
To imply but stop short of saying explicitly.
defs.ex: Are you suggesting that I killed my wife?

defs.d: To make one suppose; cause one to suppose (something).
defs.ex: The name "hamburger" suggests that hamburgers originated from Hamburg.

defs.d: A necessary commodity, a staple requirement.
defs.ex: Rice is a basic for many Asian villagers.

defs.d: An elementary building block, e.g. a fundamental piece of knowledge.
defs.ex: Arithmetic is a basic for the study of mathematics.

defs.d: Necessary, essential for life or some process.
defs.ex: Flour is a basic ingredient of bread.

defs.d: Elementary, simple, fundamental, merely functional.
defs.ex: The Hotel Sparta’s accommodation is very basic.

defs.d: A knot; a fastening.
A knot of hair, as at the back of a wig.
(usually followed by the particle "to") To hope; to wish (something, or something to be accomplished); be intent upon
defs.ex: He intends to go to university.

defs.d: To fix the mind on; attend to; take care of; superintend; regard.
Pertaining to the environment.
The act of destining or appointing.
Purpose for which anything is destined; predetermined end, object, or use; ultimate design.
Inevitably; of necessity.
defs.ex: It is not necessarily true that children get their morals from their parents.

defs.d: A perfect and/or early example of a particular style.
An artistic work of lasting worth, such as a film or song.
Of or relating to the first class or rank, especially in literature or art.
Exemplary of a particular style; defining a class/category.
The state of being free, of not being imprisoned or enslaved.
defs.ex: Having recently been released from prison, he didn't know what to do with his newfound freedom.

defs.d: The lack of a specific constraint, or of constraints in general; a state of being free, unconstrained.
defs.ex: Every child has a right to freedom from fear and freedom from want.

defs.d: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially, without vibration of the vocal cords.
(usually in the plural) A rumor.
defs.ex: There are whispers of rebellion all around.

defs.d: To speak softly, or under the breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter words without sonant breath; to talk without that vibration in the larynx which gives sonorous, or vocal, sound.
To mention privately and confidentially, or in a whisper.
To take an oath, to promise.
To use offensive, profane, or obscene language.
